title: Perception and attention
summary: Routes for vision, touch, hearing and speech, feedback from the cortex to the thalamus, and the attention networks, from the walkthroughs of an open-source 3D brain guide. Seven figures, ending with a draggable normalization model of how priority for one sense reduces the others.

source.label: Juan Bermudez, Perception & Attention (open source, MIT), 2026
